key_points: Insider activity is option-exercise and post-exercise selling (David Howard $3.04M, Denise Kulikowsky $879K, plus later sales proposals). This is routine, non-discretionary selling and carries little bearish signal.
Cantor Fitzgerald initiates coverage; combined with recent momentum and pricing-power commentary on Coach, this is mildly positive sentiment flow but no new thesis-relevant information.
Jefferies trims its position, Pictet lowers its holding, and analysts cut TPR targets by an average $0.83 to $99.50. These are modest portfolio tweaks, mostly after last week's ~5% pop.
'Solid earnings reflect strength' echoes TPR's 10/29 FQ1 beat (EPS and revenue above consensus). The driver is already largely priced in after the recent stock move.
No new guidance, regulatory, or M&A catalyst in this batch. Hold existing positioning and watch the next earnings and holiday-sell-through data for any update to the thesis.
